title: Lock character/product consistency across all shots by uploading and locking…
content:
Lock character/product consistency across all shots by uploading and locking reference assets (Seedance 2.5 supports up to 50 refs).  
Use timestamped prompts to specify the exact second each action should happen within a 30‑second timeline.  
Use white‑model control to direct motion/camera movement instead of relying on random generation.  
Generate the full 30‑second brand film as a single native 30s 4K output straight from Seedance 2.5 for stable long shots.
